AppBar.purpose: A clay header for branding, navigation and top-level actions. The clay default is sticky and remains in document flow; choose fixed or absolute for an overlay.

color.description: Theme palette color. Inherit keeps a clay surface with inherited text color; transparent removes the fill and clay shadow.

Card.purpose: A rounded Paper surface for related content and actions. Compose with CardHeader, CardContent and CardActions.

elevation.description: Depth level. Defaults to 1, or 2 when raised. An outlined card is flat.

raised.description: Increase the default elevation when elevation is not explicitly set.

inflated.description: Opt into SVG dome shading; render ClayLighting once on the page. Ignored on outlined and zero-elevation cards.

astro.example: Download your latest statement. View statement

svelte.example: Download your latest statement. View statement

CardActions.purpose: Padded flex row for a card's actions. Wraps where space is limited.

content: Default slot: buttons, links or other actions.
children: buttons, links or other actions.

CardContent.purpose: Padded content region for a Card. Accepts native div attributes.

CardHeader.purpose: Card title and secondary text with optional leading avatar and trailing action.

title.description: Plain text title; for markup use the bridge's slot or snippet.

subheader.description: Plain secondary text; for markup use the bridge's slot or snippet.

disableTypography.description: Render the title and subheader without their built-in typography wrappers.

content: Named slots: avatar, title, subheader, action. The title and subheader slots take precedence over text props.
astro.example:
AQ

Account

Edit

content: Optional avatar and action snippets. Both title and subheader can be passed as snippets instead of strings.
svelte.example:
{#snippet avatar()}AQ{/snippet} {#snippet title()}

Account

{/snippet} {#snippet action()}Edit{/snippet}

Divider.purpose: Native horizontal rule used to separate sections or, with vertical orientation, items in a row.

flexItem.description: Stretch a vertical divider across the height of its flex row.

variant.description: Full span, a leading inset, or equal space on both ends. Vertical inset and middle both add top and bottom margins.

content: No content slots; Divider is a void element.
astro.example: Settings Support

content: No snippets; Divider is a void element.
svelte.example: Settings Support

Typography.purpose: Apply the clay type scale to readable text. Use as or variantMapping to choose semantic HTML independently of visual styling.

as.description: Override the rendered tag. By default headings map to h1–h6, button/caption/overline to span, and other variants to p.

variantMapping.description: Optional variant-to-tag overrides. Explicit as takes precedence.

color.description: Palette ink color. Both the dotted and camelCase text names are accepted.

noWrap.description: Keep text on one line and show an ellipsis when width is constrained.

content: Default slot: text and inline markup.
astro.example:
<Typography variant="h4" as="h2" gutterBottom>Account settings</Typography>
<Typography color="text.secondary">Manage your profile and notifications.</Typography>

svelte.example:
<Typography variant="h4" as="h2" gutterBottom>Account settings</Typography>
<Typography color="text.secondary">Manage your profile and notifications.</Typography>

Accordion.purpose: A native details disclosure with a visible summary and a clay content well. Collapsed content stays mounted. The optional native name attribute groups panels so only one opens at a time.

defaultExpanded.description: Start open when expanded is not supplied. Only read at initial render.

disabled.description: Prevent activation of the summary without forcing the panel closed.

expanded.description: Explicit initial open state. Overrides defaultExpanded. After render the browser owns the native open property.

content: Use the summary named slot for the visible disclosure label.
events: Native toggle on the root details element, including programmatic changes. Read details.open for the current state.
astro.example:
Billing details

Your billing information is up to date.

Billing details: open

expanded.description: Current open state. Supports bind:expanded and overrides defaultExpanded.

onChange.description: Optional callback (event: Event, expanded: boolean) => void for native changes; own parent-driven expanded changes do not invoke it.

content: summary: required snippet containing the disclosure label.
events: onChange(event, expanded) reports a native state change; ontoggle exposes the native event, including programmatic changes.
svelte.example:
changes++}> {#snippet summary()}Billing details{/snippet}

Your billing information is up to date.

Billing details: {expanded ? 'open' : 'closed'}. Native changes: {changes}.
